national_news.title: India's Space Economy Projected to Reach USD 40-45 Billion in 7-8 Years
bullets: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh announced that India's space economy is expected to grow from USD 9 billion to USD 40-45 billion in the next 7 to 8 years.
The announcement was made during a media roundtable on 'Space, Sovereignty and New Economy' organised by the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi.
Key growth drivers include public-private partnerships, domestic and international investments, faster regulatory approvals, and sustainable business models.

national_news.title: Space Economy Growth Trajectory Driven by Private Reforms and Downstream Services
bullets: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh highlighted that space sector opening (2019–2020) and bodies like IN-SPACe are enabling India's growth toward a $40–45 billion space economy.
The government emphasizes a use-case-based approach, acting as anchor customers through proof-of-concept projects to create predictable demand for private space firms.

Beyond satellite launches, economic value will increasingly stem from downstream services, geospatial applications, Earth observation, and space-based disaster management support provided to neighbors like Myanmar, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka.

national_news.title: Aadhaar Authentication Made Mandatory for PM CARES for Children Scheme
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment notified that Aadhaar authentication or proof of possession is now required to avail scholarship benefits under the PM CARES for Children Scheme.
The scheme provides financial assistance for continuing education from Class 1st to 12th for children who lost their parents or legal guardians to the COVID-19 pandemic.

No child will be denied assistance due to lack of Aadhaar; alternative identity verification methods such as birth certificates, passports, voter IDs, and biometric/OTP-based verification will be allowed.
